title: Bounded holomorphic functions under one-sided negative curvature
exact_target: Must a complex domain diffeomorphic to $R^{2m}$, $m\geq 2$, carrying a complete smooth Kähler metric with $sec\leq -1$ possess a nonconstant bounded holomorphic function? No finite lower bound on sectional curvature is imposed.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
